name: hr-candidate-screening
description: Recruiting loop: a recruiter screens an application against the role's must-haves, a three-person panel reviews in parallel (technical / values / role-fit), a synthesizer writes the debrief, and the hiring manager makes the LOCKED hire call. Showcases `converge` for a review panel and a `lock` for the accountable hire/no-hire decision a human must own.

inputs.name: application
inputs.description: The candidate application — resume / profile plus the role they applied for (upload or paste).

phases.name: screen
panel
phases.description: Three independent reads of the same candidate, run concurrently; summarizer writes the debrief.

converge.name: technical
values
role-fit

phases.name: decision
